decisions.reason: The air quality sensor has its own product page and fits the growing environmental sensing demand, so results look satisfactory and give no reason for problemistic search.
As the new 3.0 generation replacing an older module, it represents the current core of the platform and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
The MQTT proxy is low-cost software that extends the platform's connectivity and runs on existing slack in API generation, so it is easy to carry.
The CAN bus module serves industrial automation customers, and despite only a brief mention it matches the firm's modular expansion strategy without signaling a shortfall.
The CO2 sensor has its own page and targets solid demand from schools and building automation, so performance likely meets aspirations.
The touch panel accessory complements existing modules at modest carrying cost, and the firm's iterative development slack allows it to stay while results mature.
